correctness.rationale: The explicit finite 27-vertex/42-edge graph enumeration has 7,594,361 total faces. The complete 3,797,088-pair matching is checked globally acyclic by topological sorting 61,837,314 directed Hasse incidences on all 7,594,360 nonempty faces. The resulting one zero-cell, 173 eight-cells and ten nine-cells have an exact signed 10×173 attaching matrix. The indicated ten columns form a determinant -1 minor; by the Hurewicz theorem and integral cell cancellation the homotopy type is a wedge of exactly 163 eight-spheres. The independent Euler characteristic is 164. All pivotal calculations are re-executable from standalone C++17 source.

value.rationale: The n=9 rectangular grid is the first width where the retracted prior all-width homotopy calculation explicitly predicts nonexistent higher-dimensional homology. The 2026 homology paper formulates the single-dimensional wedge problem as a conjecture. An integral homotopy classification at this first problematic width is mathematically motivated, and a full Morse-differential primitive minor is a nontrivial structural upgrade over existing Betti tables, not a routine unmotivated parameter increment.
